## Preflight

`tmp/pass/d7n-ollama-host-preflight.log.txt` named the expected baseline `98e9c340…`, guide hash prefix `2b76b363`, and every audit control failing at `exit=1`. Evidence present and matching, so the unit proceeded.

## Two decisions worth your attention

**`tests/setup.test.ts:140`** — the `above` pointer sits in the message string of an unreachable `throw`, not a comment. The fix brief names the site; the host brief requires runtime tokens preserved. I changed the pointer word only. The string occurs once in the repository and the case's own assertion is untouched.

**Table geometry** — the `Shape` column widened from 84 to 115 to admit the signatures, so the header, separator, and every row were re-padded by hand. I could not run a formatter, so I verified the result read-only: the anchored pattern `^\| .{26} \| .{9} \| .{115} \| .{171} \|$` matches the header, separator, and every data row, none missing. I phrased the `DEFAULT_KEEP_ALIVE` description to hold the `Summary` column at its existing 171, so no unrelated row shifted. `oxfmt --write` remains authoritative over this alignment and must run before the check gates.

Every shell gate — `git status`, `oxfmt`, `oxlint`, `check`, `docs` and both write directions, `test:guides`, `test:policy`, `test:src:server`, and the pilot diffs. The propagation must precede the check gates, since the re-padding and the paired description edits are what those directions settle.
